identifier.description: unique identifiying string for the export schem

name.description: name for the export, will be used in UI

file_prefix.description: prefix being printed as first thing of the file

file_suffix.description: suffix which is printed as the last thing of the file.

entity_type.description: type of element, if its a group or field

prefix.description: prefix being printed before group once

suffix.description: suffix being printed after group once

item_prefix.description: prefix being printed before each element of group

item_suffix.description: suffix being printed after each element of group

left_empty.description: content to be printed when nothing related to this identifer. default empty

entity_type.description: type of element, if its a group or field or structure

prefix.description: prefix being printed before structure once

suffix.description: suffix being printed after structure once

entity_type.description: type of element, if its a group or field

item_prefix.description: prefix being printed before each element of group

item_suffix.description: suffix being printed after each element of group

left_empty.description: content to be printed when nothing related to this identifer. default empty. left_empty is not printed if skip_if_empty is true for an element and it has no value

skip_if_empty.description: IF True: Skip other output from fields on same level in the same structure/group in a export item, if this is empty (=no field with that name or empty value), Default False. If this is true and no content is printed for this subitems, also no prefix or suffix from 'above' group /structure is printed.
